name: edge-cms
description: Build and update Edge CMS sites in a Hub without a Hub checkout: the edge-block-package, edge-design-to-site, edge-figma-design and vue-to-block-migrator skills, and the Hub's remote CMS tools (draft-only).

interface.shortDescription: Build and edit Edge CMS sites as drafts in a Hub
interface.longDescription: The Edge CMS skills (block packages, design to site, Figma design, Vue/HTML to block migration) and the Hub's remote CMS tools. Everything the tools change is a draft: people publish pages and release blocks in the Hub. Sign in with your Hub account the first time the tools are used.
